product_overview: A light-theme karate tournament operations console for organizers and officials to configure events, generate tiesheets, and run live matches. It is designed for fast, high-contrast use in busy gym environments.
core_goals: Configure tournament setup details, categories, and schedule rules
Generate and deploy competition tiesheets and match structures
Run live match operations with real-time score and match control

features.name: Tournament Setup Wizard
features.description: Lets tournament organizers configure event details, categories, scheduling rules, and generate the competition structure before deployment.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter credentials -> Submit login form -> See authenticated access -> Navigate to a competition setup page -> Pick a date range -> Create categories -> Upload files -> Configure judge counts -> Save draft -> Deploy to production

Navigate to /login -> Enter credentials -> Submit login form -> See authenticated access -> Navigate to a competition setup page -> Pick a date range -> Create categories -> Upload files -> Configure judge counts -> Save draft

features.name: Real-time Scoreboard and Operator Console
features.description: Allows officials to manage live matches by moving bouts between queues and controlling scoring and penalties in real time.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter credentials -> Submit login form -> See authenticated access -> Navigate to the operator console -> Drag and drop matches between mat queues -> Start matches -> Pause matches -> Update score points -> Update penalties

Navigate to /login -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit login form -> See login validation feedback -> Correct the credentials -> Submit login form -> See authenticated access -> Navigate to the operator console -> Drag and drop matches between mat queues

tech_stack.State Management: React Hooks, Zod, Zube (Firebase Realtime SDK)
